name: App icons
description: A picture of your own for an app, chosen on a phone, shown on Home and in the Inputs list instead of the app's own icon; and a backdrop per app for Home's Top Shelf.
about: Your own picture for an app, chosen on a phone. Hold OK on an app and choose Change icon, scan the code, pick a picture and see it in a dock tile and a grid tile before you send it. Shows on Home and in the Inputs list; Reset gives the app its own icon back. With Top Shelf on (Customise > Look), each app can also get a backdrop, a 16:9 picture shown behind Home while the app is focused in the dock. It also gives the voice assistant and AI agents one tool, icons (which apps have a picture of their own).
